sloka: तं रथस्थमथो दृष्ट्वा सुषेणो वानरोत्तमः ।गिरिशृङ्गेण महता रथमाशु न्यपातयत् ।। ६.४३.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ rathasthamatho dṛṣṭvā suṣeṇo vānarottamaḥ ।giriśṛṅgeṇa mahatā rathamāśu nyapātayat ।। 6.43.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Vidyunmali seeing Sushena, the monkey leader got a huge rock, and hit him on his chest with the mace.
